1479-3257-8293.description:

Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.

Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Repeat.

When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1543-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1543-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Avatar Kuruk.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning The Legend of Kuruk from exile to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate a Planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1418-1651-2638-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.

Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

972-2187-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2187-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Possessed Skaab by paying its mana cost.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab and the Great Whale token.
When the Possessed Skaab and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2187-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Possessed Skaab instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.
